avis.titre: Lightweight, Effective, and Worth the Price
avis.texte: I recently bought this product and I'm really impressed. The texture is silky and lightweight — it absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy film. It has a soft, subtle scent that disappears after a few seconds. Over the past two weeks, I've noticed that my skin feels more hydrated and my makeup goes on smoother. I didn't experience any irritation, which is a big plus for me since I have sensitive skin. The packaging is practical enough — the pump dispenser works well, though I wish the bottle was a little more travel-friendly (glass + size). For the price, I think this product is a good value, especially because a little goes a long way. I would definitely buy it again, especially for daily use. Recommended for: People with normal to dry skin looking for a hydrating yet lightweight product.

avis.titre: Wish I read the reviews first
avis.texte: I've had nothing but good experiences with Cerave until I used this facial cleanser, so I just want to make it clear that this review has nothing to do with Cerave on a more generalized scale. This solution was incompatible with my skin (combo skin; rosacea does run in the family), so that's the only reason why it's getting one star. To me, this Cerave product is just an outlier. Other than this one-off less than mediocre cleanser, Cerave is an excellent, dependable brand. I used this facial cleanser for a little under a week and noticed my face started breaking out and was getting dry. So I just switched back to the Cerave green facial cleanser, which is my go to.
